jobs.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create a premium new board game BOX for PERCH. Original illustration and composition: lively colorful sculpted songbirds flocking over a magical suburban garden at sunset, wooden bird houses, blooming branches, picket fence, tiered stone fountain, cozy cottage in distance. Friendly red cardinal, blue bird, golden yellow finch, lime green songbird and charcoal black bird. Beautiful tactile miniature 3D diorama, sophisticated illustrated textures, cornflower twilight blue and warm honey light. Entire upright square thick box at 3/4 angle, large clear margin on muted midnight-blue studio backdrop. Front title text exactly "Perch" in large cream playful serif lettering, side spine same title. No publisher logos, no extra text or watermark. Not a replica of retail artwork. Square image.
